messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: ggplot2 0.9.3.1 released
parts:
Hi everyone -

ggplot2 0.9.3.1 has been released, and should reach your local CRAN mirror soon. This version is a maintenance release which fixes a few bugs introduced by 0.9.3. The most notable changes are:

* The grouping with stat_summary() has been reverted to the old behavior, from before 0.9.3. Previous to 0.9.3, plots like this would draw lines with means at each x value:
  ggplot(mtcars, aes(x=cyl, y=mpg)) + geom_point() +
   stat_summary(geom="line", fun.y="mean")

The behavior changed in 0.9.3, so that lines wouldn't be drawn, but in 0.9.3.1, it draws lines again.

This fix breaks the behavior geom_crossbar when used with a continuous x axis. For example, a plot like this will now look messed up:
  ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = cyl, y = mpg)) + geom_point() +
    stat_summary(fun.data=mean_cl_boot, colour="red", geom="crossbar", width=0.2)

The workaround is to explicitly use the x variable as a grouping variable:
  ggplot(mtcars, aes(x=cyl, y=mpg)) + geom_point() +
    stat_summary(aes(group=cyl), fun.data=mean_cl_boot, colour="red",
                 geom="crossbar", width=0.2)


* stat_density2d now works properly with geom="polygon".


For a full list of changes, see http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/ggplot2/NEWS


-Winston
